Willowmere Lodge to Reopen

June 3 (Kestrel Bay)—The popular lakeside resort Willowmere Lodge, which has been shut since May 30 because of high water levels, has announced that it will most likely resume operations on June 9. The lake is expected to fall back to normal by June 7, restoring safe conditions for boating. Marta Ilves, who took over Willowmere Lodge three years ago, plans to offer a special reduction for guests. “Our two-day pass will be cut by 20 percent for the remainder of the summer,” she explained. Ms. Ilves also said that any visitor who books a lakeview suite will be able to use the evening barbecue each night at no charge. Because many businesses in the village of Kestrel Bay depend on summer holidaymakers, it is hoped that these offers will draw a large number of visitors to the area.
